title: ActionWait long-poll messages
description: Request/response bodies for POST {actionWaitHost}/await (Altium-proprietary; used by public clients). See SPEC.md §4.

token.description: The wait token — the same high-entropy value used as the OAuth `state` in the authorize request.

awaitSuccessResponse.description: Body of a 200 response: the authorization result.

code.description: OAuth authorization code; exchange at the token endpoint.

state.description: Echoes the wait token; the client MUST verify it matches before using `code`.

$comment: Status semantics (not expressible in JSON Schema): 200 = result ready (awaitSuccessResponse); 408 = normal idle timeout, reconnect with the same token; 410 = token no longer valid, restart sign-in; other = error.
